signatureCocktails.name: GALAXY
signatureCocktails.description: Blueberry purée and passion fruit over pineapple and lemon, lifted by blue curaçao and rosemary-infused vodka.

signatureCocktails.name: BLUE HAWAIIAN CLARIFIER
signatureCocktails.description: A clarified tropical serve of blue curaçao, pineapple, coconut milk and white rum.

signatureCocktails.name: MIDNIGHT COLADA
signatureCocktails.description: An indulgent tropical creation where coconut and pineapple meet deep dark chocolate and aromatic cocoa bitters.

signatureCocktails.name: MANGO FUEGO
signatureCocktails.description: Ripe mango and bright citrus meet chili-infused tequila for a vibrant, spicy finish.

signatureCocktails.name: HIBISCUS VELVET
signatureCocktails.description: Hibiscus and raspberry layered with soft vanilla and bright orange, lifted by vodka and triple sec.

signatureCocktails.name: MIDNIGHT GROVE
signatureCocktails.description: A deep, aromatic composition of blueberry and fresh basil, lifted by citrus and a subtle ginger warmth over white rum.

signatureCocktails.name: GOLDEN MERIDIAN
signatureCocktails.description: A luminous composition of tequila and rum, sharpened with yuzu and ginger, then rounded by tropical pineapple.

signatureCocktails.name: SOLAR ECLIPSE
signatureCocktails.description: A vibrant composition of passion fruit and citrus, layered with grenadine for a refined balance of brightness, sweetness and depth.

signatureCocktails.name: ROYAL NOCTURNE
signatureCocktails.description: An opulent composition of dark berries, saffron and pistachio, lifted by citrus and ginger.

signatureCocktails.description: A mock-up cask-inspired serve of oak-aged rum and cognac, rounded by maple, walnut and orange bitters.

signatureCocktails.name: RUBY AGAVE
signatureCocktails.description: A mock-up tequila signature of hibiscus and ruby grapefruit, rounded by agave and a pink-pepper warmth.

signatureCocktails.name: GOLDEN RITUAL
signatureCocktails.description: A mock-up ceremonial serve of cognac, honey and saffron, lifted by lemon and a champagne finish.

signatureCocktails.name: CARTHAGE ROSE
signatureCocktails.description: A mock-up Tunisian-inspired gin serve of rose, pomegranate and orange blossom — a contemporary nod to Carthage.

signatureCocktails.name: GILDED PETAL
signatureCocktails.description: A mock-up petal-light composition of elderflower, white peach and jasmine, finished with a gilded edge.

signatureCocktails.name: VELVET BLOOM
signatureCocktails.description: A mock-up silky serve of lychee, rose and vanilla, rounded with cream for a velvet finish.

signatureCocktails.name: CRIMSON VEIL
signatureCocktails.description: A mock-up dark berry composition of blackberry, cassis and amaro, veiled in a hint of smoke.
